summary.text: Robert Richard-Snipes is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A nonprofit professional, he has a career in housing, mental health and substance use recovery and says he is running on affordable housing, treatment, public education and jobs.

paragraphs.text: Richard-Snipes earned a high school diploma from Matthew Fontaine Maury High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2012, followed by a graduate degree in 2020 and a degree from UNH's College of Professional Studies in 2022.
His career experience includes working as a nonprofit professional.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Richard-Snipes said he was raised by a single mother and combat veteran who served five deployments, and that his career has been in nonprofit leadership, housing, mental health and substance use recovery.
Richard-Snipes advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary.

In the survey, he said he would work to expand affordable housing, strengthen mental health and substance use treatment, and invest in public education, and that he would support good-paying jobs, fair wages and paid family leave.
